test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. D is the immediate neighbour of G and A. F sits second to the left of G. E is the immediate neighbour of C and A.

How many people sit between C and B when counted from the left of B?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1. F sits second to the left of G. 

2. D is the immediate neighbour of G and A.

3. E is the immediate neighbour of C and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97fc38e5d2bc3d9a3bf329bfa7bd226033b2620ec11bd443a39619b2956a52c8.png] 

B, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/791d84db195ae118ce6ccd3d223d8be0f8d87bf6e6f1c52215b58db42d8bb03b.png] 

Thus, one people sit between C and B when counted from the left of B.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
